sources.name: GaneshaSpeaks
sources.text: You may choose to take pains for the sake of others, which seems to be highly fulfilling. Your good spirit will sky-rocket by evening. Make sure to change your disadvantage into your advantage, says Ganesha.

sources.name: Horoscope.com
sources.text: There's some likelihood that something you need or want has been eluding your grasp. The somewhat strained aspect of the heavens lately hasn't helped. But today everything is within reach, especially if it was material considerations holding you back. You have an auspicious day ahead, so make the most of it!

sources.name: Astrology.com
sources.text: Though you might benefit from venting to a confidant, don't share your problems with multiple people. Remember that gossip can do serious damage, and focus on cultivating better communication techniques. Consider commissioning a third party to walk you through conflict resolution when the Sun and Luna align this evening. Prepare to take accountability for your own shortcomings and avoid shielding yourself from the truth while Mercury and Saturn highlight imbalances. Enjoy a bit of alone time to settle your nerves and recharge once Luna enters Aries tonight.

sources.name: AstroSage
sources.text: Outdoor sports will attract you-Meditation and yoga will bring gains. Today, with the help of a close friend, some businessmen are likely to gain monetary benefits. This money can overcome many of your troubles. By sharing your problems with your family members, you feel lightheaded. However, your ego doesn't allow you to share numerous important things, which is not right. Doing so will only increase the troubles. Mental turmoil and turbulence as work pressure builds up. Relax towards the later half of the day. You will feel that your creativity has been lost and you find it extremely difficult to make decisions. After completing household chores, housewives of this zodiac sign can watch a movie on TV or get engaged in their mobile phones in the free time today. Your spouse might burst out on you over a not-so-happening conjugal life that you have.

readings.text: This is perfect day to call for major official business meetings with your team or with your clients. It’s going to be successful and will contribute to your financial progress.

You may need more than ever to spend time focusing the lens on your goals. These aspects can create wonderful ideas or just downtime to ponder and woolgather. Future-oriented thoughts and ideas are featured as you think about how to take them to a wider and more profitable market. readings.text: It may be heavy at work today. You might feel totally packed, hence Ganesha feels, that you shouldn’t overtax yourself and relax in between work. From the health and mood viewpoint, it may be a dim day, hence you shouldn’t strain yourself much.

A "hot under the collar" feeling might plague you today. Working out your own health regimen is very challenging. There is an initial phase of voices inside the head saying things like, "Feed me ice cream or I will hate you!" and "I'm too tired to exercise!" With practice you will learn to calm them down with, "You will feel better and it won't take that long!" and "I'd rather you eat this fruit salad with fresh raspberry sauce." Yum!
